I wish them well if so. There's also the crashes everyone's complaining about, I mainly blame the lack of information showed in the system requirements, but it's likely some easily avoidable issue All of this aside, it's an interesting title for the beginning of the developer's legacy and I do hope to see them "bloom".

[h1] A Charming game with unused Potential [/h1] The game's development was posted on Tiktok and seemed to be shown as a "destroy stuff sim" and looked fun although honestly likely to get boring fast. this was not the case for the actual release of the game however, now being a tower defense. i was apprehensive at first to enjoy it but i will admit its a decent little game, especially for being free! [h3] However. [/h3] The game runs AWFULLY when there are too many projectiles on screen and also is very prone to crashing at those levels of stress. Like other reviews mention, ashes are annoying to collect, same with seeds for trees, becoming tedious. Gaia upgrades are basically pointless once you have a single or two rings of trees that fire projectiles, which is all but one of them. The game area is a boring sand colour, would be very cool if over the course of planting trees or waves it got progressively more green and flowery, this would also clearly show your impact on the planet. Characters/skins have no description of what it is that makes them unique. All in all it is a free game so i cannot really complain, but as someone that followed the development i am slightly disappointed that this is its release state. it would be very cool if the destroying things and power usage that was shown on TikTok was its own separate game mode. For a free game its decent, but i wouldn't recommend it for a log haul time waster due to the technical issues.

画风可爱的肉鸽塔防游戏。主要内容是通过种植不同种类的树木来保护神树免遭人类的破坏。玩家操控的黑色怪物可以添加不同攻击方式的触手，外围的一圈树木一共有6种，树木可以在防御了一波人类后购买也可以在地图上捡到，每种完一圈树木会有新的一圈位置可以种。 优点： 1.画风很令人舒适。 2.关卡难度不算太高，理解游戏玩法后很容易坚持很多波，树木的获取也不难，20波树木可以种到7圈以上。 3.设定和玩法还算比较新颖。 4.暂时免费！！！ 缺点： 1.种植树木必须对准定好的圆点然后按空格，但是玩的时候经常对不准就需要反复调整，左手awsd按得巨累，希望以后可以出辅助种树的功能。 2.总地来说玩法还是比较单一，玩不了多久就会无聊，输了之后再开一把又是一样的，再加上种树确实很累，就不想再玩了。 3.没有英文，我成就完成了80%也没看懂一些东西是啥意思，比如这个ashes是指树木发射的子弹吗？那为啥有的又用的bullets？我猜ashes指的这个黑色怪物的触手？还有一些升级选项不太理解，可能是我英语太差了吧。但是总地来说有一点点英语基础就没有太大的问题，还是可以玩明白的。像spear、jaws、hammer、refresh这些单词都很简单。 总地来说还是可以一试的，毕竟免费，用来打发打发时间是一个不错的选择。已购买DLC表示支持。

Good concept, poor execution. Gameplay is objectively fun, but the controls are horrendous and the game crashes constantly. It has no limit for bullets on the screen, no limits of upgrades, no limits for... anything, really. Fun until you realize your framerate is only going lower and there are no settings to fix it. Crashes are inevitable. Lag is inevitable. If you have a computer powerful enough to run this game, you're better off buying a better title elsewhere.
